events.title: Release date!
events.summary: It's been a (relatively) long road.Badass Brigade is the first game I've ever made. The only relevant experience I had going in was modding for Starcraft 2. IYKYK. events.summary: Lots of behind the scenes work has been done, most of which is not in the demo (sorry), but that doesn't mean nothing has changed.Unlockable weapons found in missions 1 and 2 have been largely changed. These weapons were created early in development and aren't as interesting as some of the later ones. I figured the beginning of the game could use some more excitement. events.title: Demo Release on the 30th!
events.summary: The demo is almost here! Thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest!Content available in the demo is the tutorial + first two missions. That's around 2-3 hours of game (or 1 if you're me). Please leave your feedback wherever you like or write a review with what you love, like, or hate. Join the discord!: https://discord.gg/bGSEj6UC5g

events.title: It's playtest time!
events.summary: Hello friends!Badass Brigade is officially open for playtesting. The actual game content available is the beginning of the game without any alterations. Here's exactly what that means:Tutorial + first 3 missions. A mission should take around 1 hour+ to complete at my best estimate. For context, personally it takes me 30 minutes to clear a mission while getting every secret and knowing exactly where to go and what to do while absolutely crushing every enemy encounter.1 Training side mission.
